question: Do net-redemption fund half-years coincide with net stock selling, and does beginning book bank money plus settlement reserve further distinguish those cases?
decision_use: qualify or reject the interpretation of reported redemptions as stock-selling pressure before considering any new low-frequency return study; no trading action
strategy_layer: external institutional narrative/research, no LEI technical rule or hard filter

universe.selection: same two already chosen continuing funds; not industry representative or independent untouched evidence

new_information: all-stock buy and sell transaction totals and comparable beginning bank/monetary-fund plus settlement-reserve balance, each from original financial statements

definitions.N: sell_total_cny - buy_total_cny; retain signed value, no clipping; transaction amount excluding fees, not settled cash
definitions.D_adjusted: D_report + reinvest_cny; Huaxia inclusion in subscription amount remains accounting-structure inference
definitions.C0: beginning bank/monetary funds plus beginning settlement reserve; both components saved; no claim unrestricted available cash
definitions.G: D - C0, signed difference only, no compulsory-selling label
definitions.scale: divide each signed measure by same beginning net assets; also preserve CNY amounts
definitions.half_year_derivation: H1 totals directly; H2=FY-H1 cumulative trade totals; H2 opening balance=H1 ending balance; H1 opening balance=original prior-year-end comparison column

time_semantics: retrospective same-half behavior; flows and transaction totals only public after period end; even beginning balances may only be disclosed later; no contemporaneous prediction claim
main_comparison: For each fund and both fixed D definitions, compare N>0 counts and signed N/NAV median in D>0 versus D<=0 periods; all 28 rows retained
cash_increment: Only among each fund D>0 cases, compare D>C0 and D<=C0 counts and signed N/NAV medians against all same-fund D>0 cases, retain all raw period rows and the range of D/NAV in each cell
increment_identification: if groups absent or redemption-size ranges do not overlap, explicitly cannot distinguish cash extra explanation; no model, matching, threshold change or added fund to rescue identification
counterexamples: D>0 with N<=0 directly rejects necessity of aggregate net selling, but does not exclude some individual forced sales; same 14 half-years show both funds side-by-side, show by fund/year and all reversals
uncertainty: descriptive counts, exact amounts, coverage and per-year cases; 2 funds and 14 shared periods not 28 independent trials, no significance or probability-generalization claim
missing: no zero fill; source missing blocks dependent calculation; both trade totals and C0/NAV require original verification
required_qualification: full total section not top-20 or above-2pct list
gross transactions excluding fees and CNY
cash components aligned and current sum matches asset summary
H1 and FY prior-end balances same; precedingFY continuity; accounting-classification changes kept not forced
preinspection: Five original reports per fund seen before full design, including trade totals; this is openly exploratory history, not unseen validation
financial_hypothesis: redemptions may require asset sales when liquid resources limited; competing portfolio rearrangement, bonds/repo, fund distributions, accrued receivables/payables and intra-half cash timing can break this association

literature.Coval_Stafford: prior read source retained; NBER fetch 2026-10-24 returned403, not new full-text verification
literature.Wardlaw_2020: author abstract live read; warns mechanically embedding contemporaneous stock return in pressure measurements; no replication claim

execution: one fixed descriptive matrix, zero fits, zero price or return/IC runs; necessary extraction and independent numerical audit only; no parameters optimized
stop: close bounded behavior question after qualified comparison and independent reconciliation; no automatic reopening sealed return uses; genuinely identifying new timing/cash/trade evidence required for further causality
allowed: new research-only scripts/reports in new raw and report path
external ordinary outputs via fixed storage plan
own registry/INDEX/progress and coordination exact updates
state: source extraction active; no grouped behavior calculations yet
